Maria (PM): Quick sync — recruiting for a closed private preview focused on on‑prem customers. Need ~6 installs + a feedback contract. Who can own outreach and legal touchpoints?
Sam (Eng): I can take 2 installs, will need Eng time for install days. ETA availability?
Ava (Solutions): I can coordinate 3 customers in EMEA/APAC. Will collect legal contacts for NDAs and handle customer comms.
Jordan (SRE): Ops checklist question: we need SSH jumpbox access, ip allowlist, and agent version pinned. Also want a maintenance window plan.
Priya (Research): Want structured feedback: 5 eval prompts + weekly regression metrics. Propose a 4‑point feedback scorecard to standardize comparisons.
Maria (PM): +1 on the scorecard. Draft scoring: integration ease (1-5), latency/throughput okay (1-5), correctness/regressions (1-5), business value (1-5). Tie kickoff acceptance to integration >3.
Sam (Eng): Agreed. Also propose a preflight test script to run during install to validate runtime. Snippet:
```bash
# preflight
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1
python3 test_prompt.py --seq-len 512 --n=20
```
Ava (Solutions): Will share that with customers. We should also capture "time to first inference" as a key metric during the install.
Jordan (SRE): Ops requirements: disk >= 500GB, GPU driver >=525, kernel >=5.10, node taints & tolerations documented. I'll add specifics to onboarding doc.
Maria (PM): Contract cadence idea: 3-month preview, weekly 30m syncs for month 1 then biweekly. Compensation: $5k platform credit + SLA review session. Any redlines expected from legal or sales?
Ava (Solutions): Legal flagged a data handling clause: by default demos/logging must be off; customers explicitly opt-in to share logs. Retention cap = 30 days unless agreed. Also they want a clause for emergency access with customer approval.
Priya (Research): For feedback loop, ask customers to run our weekly eval harness and upload results CSV to a secure bucket. We'll provide automated dashboards and a short survey.
Sam (Eng): I can build a presigned S3 upload endpoint and a small runner to automate the eval. Need a credentials rotation plan and short README.
Jordan (SRE): For rollback: if median latency >1.5x baseline for 48 hours or two consecutive days, we auto-fallback to a hosted compatible variant. We should include that in the contract operational SLA.
Maria (PM): Proposed launch/graduation criteria from preview: 1) >=4 integration score for all 6 customers; 2) no critical regressions for 14 consecutive days; 3) cohort usage >=10k tokens/day aggregate; 4) completed runbook & infra checklist; 5) at least 2 customers commit to pilot expansion.
Ava (Solutions): Timeline: start outreach this week, onboard first 2 within two weeks, full cohort by EoQ. I'll prepare invite templates and a consent checklist.
Sam (Eng): Tagging eng-oncall for install window planning. @Jordan (SRE) can you confirm install bandwidth and typical install duration per customer?
Jordan (SRE): I can commit to 4 installs (3–5 hours each) during business days; weekends require overtime. We should schedule them back-to-back to reduce ramp. Also will provide an install day runbook.
squadbot: Reminder: please add the label "private_preview_feedback" to related tickets. :robot_face:
Priya (Research): Also recommend a quick NPS at day 30 + a 1‑page free‑text doc capturing top 3 blockers per customer. That will help prioritize engineering fixes.
Maria (PM): Action items: Ava — outreach + legal comms; Sam — preflight script + upload runner PR; Jordan — infra checklist + rollback wording; Priya — eval harness + dashboard; Maria — draft feedback contract and circulate. Target: contract draft by Thu 12:00 UTC.
Ava (Solutions): On it. I'll post candidate list by Wed EOD and include legal contact info.
Sam (Eng): I pushed an initial PR for the test harness: https://git.internal/r/redwood/private-preview/preflight - please review when you can.
Jordan (SRE): Added ops checklist draft to docs: https://docs.internal/redwood/onprem-onboard (see "ops" section). Please comment if anything missing.
Maria (PM): Thanks team — this looks actionable. We'll reconvene after candidate list is posted. :thumbsup:
